lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A horizontal sequence of approximately 8-12 high-luminance circular clusters is visible along the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, forming a localized grid-like arrangement on the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge runs along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side to low-intensity shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible lateral surface of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 6-8 discrete high-luminance blobs distributed across the fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct high-contrast white linear mark is located on the primary lateral ridge in the posterior half of the visible flank. A remora is attached to the ventral-posterior area.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced caustic light patterns from surface refraction are visible on the anterior-dorsal surface of the animal.
